name: (04) Serpentis — 2 Intermediate — The Form of the Cobra

system.description:
No longer caught between man and snake, you collapse fully into a giant black-and-gold cobra, a tremendous nightmare serpent that keeps its full human weight.

Expend one Blood Trait; the change takes a full three turns and cannot be accelerated. Clothing and small personal effects change with you, and you remain in serpent form until the next sunrise unless you decide to change back earlier. In this form you have a venomous bite that is poisonous to mortals, may slip through small passages, and may still use any Discipline that requires neither hands nor speech.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next sunrise or you revert
